values.note: $30 a night with 30-amp hookups, $35 at the sites with 50-amp service (shaded gray on the campground map). The fee covers one night for up to 6 people. Interagency Access/Senior pass holders pay half.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232505/rates (Peak Season 2026-04-01..2026-11-30, 2026-12-01..12-31 and 2027: 'STANDARD ELECTRIC': 30, the other site category 35) + https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/upload/Blue-Heron-Campground-Map-and-Regs-2024.pdf ('With 30 amp hook-ups - $30*', 'With 50 amp hook-ups (gray sites) - $35*', '*50% off rate for holders of Interagency Access/Senior Passes') + NPS campgrounds API ('This fee covers one night of camping for up to 6 persons'), read 2026-11-23

discounts.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/upload/Blue-Heron-Campground-Map-and-Regs-2024.pdf ('*50% off rate for holders of Interagency Access/Senior Passes'), read 2026-11-23

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/blueheroncampground.htm ('45 sites all with water and electric hook-ups'; 'Sites with 50-amp electric service are shaded in gray') + NPS campgrounds API ('All sites have 20 and 30 amp service with water. There are no sewer hookups on each site.'), read 2026-11-23

values.note: All 45 are paved back-in sites with water and electric; site 29 is a double. Posted lengths run 28-61 ft, so every site takes a 23-ft rig (lengths are measured from the curb stop to the road edge).

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/upload/Blue-Heron-CAMPGROUND-SITE-LENGTH.pdf (sites 1-45, 28-61 ft, '29 H Dbl', 'Distance measured is from the parking curb stop to the edge of roadway') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232505 (45 sites, every one 'Driveway Entry: Back-In'), read 2026-11-23

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/blueheroncampground.htm ('access to restrooms and showers and a dump station') + NPS campgrounds API (flush toilets, hot showers, dump station, potable water; laundry 'No', camp store 'No'; 'Free WiFi is available at the campground kiosk'), read 2026-11-23

values.note: The park's campground page (updated June 2026) says the campground is open year-round, and recreation.gov carries rates for December 2026 and all of 2027. The 2024 campground map still said April 1 through November 30.

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/blueheroncampground.htm ('Blue Heron Campground is open year-round and operates on the reservation system'; page 'Last updated: June 22, 2026') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232505/rates (Peak Season 2026-12-01..2026-12-31 and 2027-01-01..2027-12-31), read 2026-11-23

values.note: Reservable up to the day of arrival; sites not reserved are taken first-come. 14 consecutive nights, 30 nights a year. Check-in and check-out noon ET.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/biso/planyourvisit/blueheroncampground.htm ('Reservations may be made up to 180 days in advance'; 'Check-out and check-in time is 12:00 pm (ET)') + NPS campgrounds API ('Campsites that are not reserved are on a first-come/first-served basis throughout the season') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232505 (rules: reservationCutOff 0 days, maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 30 days each year), read 2026-11-23

note: NPS, Big South Fork National River & Recreation Area: wooded, paved campground on the plateau 9 miles west of Stearns off KY 742, a few miles from the Blue Heron mining community. Not on the water (the river gorge is below the rim). --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30-35 (rec.gov 2026/2027; 50-amp gray sites $35), 45 water+electric sites, max 61 ft, flush toilets/showers/dump, rec.gov booking. Changed pull_through true->false (every site back-in), sewer -> false, season Apr-Nov approx -> year-round (NPS page updated 2026-06). Added 180-day window, same-day cutoff with walk-up for unreserved sites, 14-night limit, senior/access 50% confirmed. Note trimmed of field-repeating text.
